# Pay Stub Printing

ClearPath Payroll provides local software tools for payroll calculation, reporting, and document preparation. It does not provide legal, tax, financial, accounting, or payroll compliance advice.

## What This Feature Does

The printable pay stub page displays payroll details for a calculated employee check at `/payroll/paystub/{payrollRunEmployeeId}`. It includes configurable display settings and local placeholders for state or local required-field review.

## Included Details

- Company name and address.
- Employee name, address, employee ID, and SSN last 4 only.
- Pay period start, pay period end, and pay date.
- Earnings, hours, rates where available, and gross pay.
- Employee taxes.
- Optional/internal employer taxes section.
- Pre-tax deductions and post-tax deductions.
- Reimbursements.
- Net pay.
- Direct deposit last 4 only or check number placeholder.
- Year-to-date placeholders.
- Employer notes.

## Display Settings

The page includes local print settings for hours, rates, YTD placeholders, employer taxes, employee address, accrual placeholders, and a state-required-fields checklist placeholder.

## Steps

1. Open `/payroll/paystub/{payrollRunEmployeeId}`.
2. Review the pay stub data.
3. Adjust display settings.
4. Review applicable pay statement requirements before distribution.
5. Select **Print Pay Stub**.

## Cautions

Do not distribute without reviewing applicable pay statement requirements. The pay stub does not show full SSNs or full bank account numbers.
